name: team-local
description: The team workflow on local Lemonade models only (Cline + provider lemonade, no cloud anywhere): Muse-Glimmer-30B (Meta) builds and plans, gemma-4-31B (Google, another family, with vision) reviews, same-model rework for 3 rounds, then the fallback dev model Laguna-XS-2.1 (Poolside, a third family) takes the task over on a sibling card (started at once); only when the fallback fails too does the card go to the orchestrator. All three models passed kanban models vet for dev and QA (2026-10-12); none was vetted for plan

dev.note: Cline on the dev tier's pick (Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF-Q4_K_M, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12)

qa.note: gemma-4-31B QAT (passed kanban models vet for QA 2026-10-12): another family (google) than the Muse-Glimmer dev model (meta) and the Laguna fallback model (poolside), with vision, so it reads screenshots

plan.note: plans run on the dev tier's model (Muse-Glimmer-30B, not vetted for plan) in Cline's plan mode (--plan), so a plan card needs no model swap

fallback.note: fallback dev model (Laguna-XS-2.1-GGUF-Q4_K_M, Poolside, a third family, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12) on the dev role's agent

candidates.note: in use (not vetted for plan; passed dev and QA 2026-10-12): the dev model, so a plan card needs no model swap; 65536 context as Lemonade loads it
candidate (not vetted for plan; passed dev and QA 2026-10-12): the fallback dev model; 65536 context as Lemonade loads it

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (the dev tier's model) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).

fallback.note: Same structure as team: after reworkRounds FAILs, a QA stall, an unchanged rework or an unresolved conflict the fallback sibling starts at once (local runs cost 0). Outages are waited out and then go to the orchestrator: every model is on the same Lemonade server, so a fallback can't get around its outage.

dev.note: dev pick (passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12): Meta's Muse Glimmer, a dense 30B with tool-calling + vision, 16.9 GB at Q4_K_M; Lemonade loads it at 65536 (its max is 131072)
the fallback dev model (tier senior), passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12: tool-calling, 65536 context as Lemonade loads it

qa.note: QA pick (passed kanban models vet for QA 2026-10-12): another family (google) than the Muse-Glimmer dev (meta) and Laguna fallback (poolside) models, vision + tool-calling, 17.6 GB at Q4_0 (QAT); Lemonade loads it at 65536

senior.note: fallback dev model (passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-12): Poolside's Laguna-XS-2.1, a third family, neither the Muse-Glimmer dev model (meta) nor the Gemma QA model (google), so its sibling is still reviewed by Gemma; tool-calling, 18.9 GB at Q4_K_M, 65536 context as Lemonade loads it. Started without approval (local runs cost 0); the core never hands a task onto the card's own model and sends a fallback sibling that fails to the orchestrator, so the takeover happens once

tierRules.dev: Lemonade models with the tool-calling label; cost 0
tierRules.qa: a different vendor (model family) than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a family other than dev and QA

tierNotes.dev: Memory budget (one GPU: Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 96 GB GPU-addressable of 125 GB RAM): dev + QA + fallback must stay resident side by side within 80 GB, leaving 16 GB headroom. Weights (Lemonade's sizes), each loaded at 65536 context: Muse-Glimmer-30B 16.9 GB, gemma-4-31B QAT 17.6 GB, Laguna-XS-2.1 18.9 GB: 53.4 GB of weights. Each model's KV cache at 65536 and its compute buffers come on top; their sizes are not measured yet, so check the free memory with all three loaded before raising a context. Change a context with lemonade load <model> --ctx-size <n> --llamacpp vulkan --save-options. Three models resident at once needs Lemonade's max_loaded_models at 3 (and models.providerCapacity.lemonade.maxLoadedModels equal to it). kanban bench calibrate can still compare candidates
tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the family from the model id (Muse → meta, Gemma → google, Laguna → poolside, Qwen → qwen, Devstral → mistral, DeepSeek → deepseek)

settings.why: Lemonade/llama.cpp ends Cline turns without the TaskComplete hook; only the turn detector in mode on ends them (report only logs), or every card sits running with an idle TUI

local models need recovery to act: a no-images rejection or an overflowing context is cleared (/clear) and resent, and a Lemonade outage (connection refused, /health down) is held and probed instead of escalated
recovery must not be switched off for this project
